newsitem.title: USA: Exxon may have to refute ads' claims - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Exxon may have to refute ads' claims - WSJ.

text.p: A settlement with the Federal Trade Commission may require Exxon Corp to begin running ads that refute its claims that its premium gasoline lowers the cost of car maintenance, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Tuesday's electronic edition, the Journal said the settlement was expected to be announced later today.
Exxon spokesman Dave Gardner told the Journal that the company is in "active negotiations" with the FTC but that the two sides "do not have an agreement finalized."
Terms of the settlement were not immediately known.

The ads had claimed that Exxon's gas lowered maintenance costs because it burned more cleanly and left fewer engine deposits. But the FTC said evidence did not support those claims, unnamed sources told the Journal.
